goal.en: Give macOS app developers a reusable SwiftUI workspace for arranging their own content in resizable panels. The SDK handles grid geometry, snapping and panel identity; the included demo shows the interactions with sample content kept only for the current session.
goal.zh: 为 macOS 应用开发者提供可复用的 SwiftUI 工作区，把自己的内容放进可调整大小的面板。SDK 处理网格几何、吸附与面板身份；附带演示应用展示这些交互，示例内容仅在本次运行中保留。

role.en: SDK and demo implementation with strict concurrency
role.zh: SDK 与演示应用，启用严格并发检查

role.en: Reusable canvas, panels and workspace controls
role.zh: 可复用画布、面板与工作区控件
可观察的布局与面板状态

role.zh: Core/UI 库与 SDK 示例编译

role.en: Generate the native demo app project

subject.en: Indigo metal information tray with adjustable dividers and four colored paper stacks
subject.zh: 带可调隔板与四色纸卡的靛蓝金属信息托盘

description.en: One sliding divider separates four unequal bays. The larger terracotta paper stack shows how space can be allocated while the complete tray remains one compact object.
description.zh: 滑动隔板分出四个大小不同的区域，较大的陶土色纸卡区体现空间分配，完整托盘形成紧凑的整体。

description.en: An indigo anodized frame, brushed-metal fittings and matte paper stacks make the adjustable workspace tangible. Continuous material shading preserves the frame, reflections and paper edges.
description.zh: 靛蓝阳极氧化边框、拉丝金属配件与哑光纸卡，把可调整的工作区转化为实物。连续的材质明暗保留边框、反光和纸张边缘。

description.en: Offset panel outlines and short alignment ticks sit on cool indigo-gray paper. The field, grain and projected shadows are separate layers, so the small application mark stays transparent.
description.zh: 冷靛灰纸面上排列错位的面板轮廓和短对齐刻线。底色、颗粒与投影独立保存，小尺寸应用标记使用透明图。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the four compartments and central divider remain distinct. At 32/24/16 px, the divided silhouette and four colors carry recognition; paper grain, metal texture and the adjustment slot merge. The native toolbar uses a 22 pt transparent mark.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能分辨四个区域和中央隔板；32/24/16 px 由分区轮廓与四色保持识别，纸张颗粒、金属纹理与滑槽细节自然合并。原生工具栏使用 22 pt 透明标记。
